title: Local codimension-one ramification criterion for a finite flat morphism
statement: Let $X,Y$ be locally Noetherian schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $f:X\to Y$ be finite and flat [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $x\in X$ with $0<\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$, where dimension is Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Suppose that for every $x'\in X$ specializing to $x$ with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x'}=1$, there is an open neighbourhood $V\subseteq X$ of $x'$ such that $V\to Y$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Then there is an open neighbourhood $W\subseteq X$ of $x$ such that $W\to Y$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

proof.text: Apply the etale singleton-fibre chart at x. Install its finite flat and locally Noetherian instances. The proved Hom.coheight_apply_of_flat and ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight identify the dimensions of both chart maps with those downstairs.

Choose the locally principal branch ideal. If g is not etale near z then g(z) lies in its support. Its stalk has positive dimension, so dimension-one support detection gives a generalization t in that support with dimension one.

The branch-support equivalence supplies w above t with no etale neighbourhood. Since g is closed, the specialization t→g(z) lifts from the closure of {w} to a point over g(z). The singleton-fibre property makes that point z. Thus w specializes to z, a(w) specializes to x, and its stalk has dimension one. The given formally unramified neighbourhood at a(w) is etale by flatness and local finite presentation (Etale.of_formallyUnramified_of_flat). The chart locus equivalence contradicts the choice of w. Hence an etale neighbourhood exists at z and descends to x by the same equivalence.

theorem exists_etale_neighbourhood_of_finite_flat_of_codimension_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsFinite f] [Flat f] (x : X)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hunram : ∀ x' : X, Specializes x' x →
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x') = 1 →
      ∃ V : X.Opens, x' ∈ V ∧ FormallyUnramified (V.ι ≫ f)) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f)
